note: Scripture authority is the Bíblia Livre (porbrbsl, public domain), quoted verbatim from the ebible mirror por_bpm via scripts/bible_mirror.py.

The English (NPNF) cites no references; every quotation was identified by hand. Each 'mined' row was re-verified by script: the quoted span is a byte-exact substring of both this body and the Bible verse. Loose, merged, Septuagint-shaped or re-personed quotations are self_rendered (Sirach is not in the Bíblia Livre).
Register: the congregation is addressed as vós (as in the shipped against-eutropius.pt); Bíblia Livre quotations keep their own você/vocês.
